text: 1、市场全天探底回升，科创50指数大涨超10%。半导体芯片股集体爆发，华虹宏力、兆易创新、北方华创、长电科技等20余股涨停，中芯国际、寒武纪等多股涨超10%。PCB、CPO等AI硬件股拉升，金禄电子、生益科技、大族激光、联特科技等多股涨停，中际旭创、光库科技等涨超10%。下跌方面，油气股逆势调整，科力股份跌近10%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超3000股飘红，今日成交2.97万亿。截止收盘沪指涨1.79%，深成指涨4.81%，创业板指涨7.05%。 2、板块概念方面，半导体、存储芯片、CPO、玻璃基板等板块涨幅居前，油气、医药医疗、白酒、猪肉等板块跌幅居前
text_en: 1. The market rebounded after a morning decline, with the STAR 50 Index surging over 10%. Semiconductor chip stocks collectively rallied, with Huawei Hongli, GigaDevice, NAURA Technology, JCET and over 20 others hitting涨停, while SMIC, Cambricon and many others rose over 10%. PCB, CPO and other AI hardware stocks gained, with Jindu Electronics, Shengyi Technology, Han's Laser, Lintel Technology and others hitting涨停, and Zhongji Innolight, Optowide Technologies rising over 10%. On the downside, oil stocks bucked the trend and fell, with Keli Shares dropping nearly 10%. Rising stocks outnumbered decliners, with over 3,000 stocks in Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen markets in the green. Total turnover was 2.97 trillion yuan. By the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.79%, the Shenzhen Component rose 4.81%, and the ChiNext Index rose 7.05%. 2. In terms of sectors, semiconductors, memory chips, CPO, glass substrates and other sectors led the gains, while oil, healthcare, baijiu, pork and other sectors lagged.
